design.name: 三彩镇墓兽
design.brief: A Tang-dynasty sancai-glazed tomb guardian beast (镇墓兽) from the Silk Road tombs, awakened by the drought goddess: a hulking quadruped lion-like beast built of hollow glazed ceramic, sitting heavy and low. A fierce human-beast face mask with bulging eyes, a single tall curved horn and flame-shaped ear crests; big flame-like sculpted wing fins on the shoulders; thick stubby legs ending in big three-clawed feet. Its body is glazed in the three sancai colours: amber-brown, malachite green and cream, with glaze drips running down. The front (face mask, chest and forelegs) is extra-thick glossy glaze armour. A big jagged crack across its back splits the ceramic open, white-gold sun fire glowing inside the hollow body (weak spot). Tank: lowers its head and horn to guard and charge.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions like the jerboa soldier and fire rat of this roster: chunky simplified masses, oversized head and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Its defence is part of its own body: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
